prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Insured reports a collision at an intersection while making a left turn. Insured states the other vehicle was approaching from the opposite direction and the impact occurred in the turn lane. Photos requested from insured and scene diagram started.

Entry 2: Claimant's representing attorney's office contacted the desk and confirmed representation. All further communication to go through counsel. Bodily injury claim noted, claimant reports neck pain consistent with whiplash. Medical authorization request sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Police report obtained. Responding officer notes both drivers gave conflicting accounts of signal phase at the intersection. Citation issued to the left-turning driver. Liability currently under review, pending witness statement follow-up.

Entry 4: Received treatment records from claimant's provider through counsel. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain with whiplash-type symptoms. Records reviewed and noted for bodily injury evaluation. Counsel has requested a call to discuss a settlement timeline.

Entry 5: Reviewed vehicle damage estimates for both vehicles and confirmed rear quarter and front bumper damage consistent with the reported impact angle. Liability assessment updated to reflect the citation and photographic evidence. File flagged for supervisor review before any offer is made through counsel.
